name: find-a-way
description: When an agent's reply leaves your request undone, says what stopped it and proposes up to three ways to get it done: a component to install, another agent to ask, a file to attach, your own agent, the request said another way, or a note to your admins.

fields.name: cause
fields.description: access, missing-file, capability, unclear, agent-error or other

fields.name: summary
fields.description: One sentence in the person's language: what stopped the request

fields.name: fixes
fields.description: Up to three ways to get it done, the likeliest first

item.name: action
item.description: install, ask-agent, attach, own-agent, rephrase or report

item.name: target
item.description: The component, the agent, the file or the note the action needs

item.name: why
item.description: One sentence: how it gets the request done

gate.question: Does the reply leave what the member asked for undone, or say the agent cannot do it?
